name: limit-schema-values-per-role-at-limit
description: The origin role carrying exactly 1,024 distinct refs, the schema's published maximum values-per-role count, canonicalises normally and sorts by NFC code point order.
notes: The schema's maximum values-per-role count is 1,024. Refs use the reserved test/ fixture namespace and are script-generated; the input array is given in reverse-sorted order so the vector also exercises the array sort at this scale. See limit-schema-values-per-role-over-limit for the one-past-limit refusal, including the pre-de-duplication counting rule.
